notes: Twelve items queued from the 2026-09-18 poll, all twelve read. The Registry paywalls every story after the headline and lede; three state enough there to extract, following the precedent of 2026-09-02, 09-10 and 09-14, and two of those three name only a multi-building complex, so they are left pending.

coverage.note: Four of the twelve name no San Francisco building: the Golden Gate Global EB-5 approval (a Lake County resort), the building-operations economics report, the AI-adoption and vacancy survey, and the Architectural Resources Group staff promotion. 395 3rd Street, 760 Market Street and the Cadillac Court and Scott Boulevard hits in every article are the related-articles rail, not reporting.

findings.description: Newmark is marketing the loan on the Phelan Building as a note sale with $140 million pricing guidance, against the $374 million the building traded for in 2016.

publish.note: Fails the ten-year test as it stands: a loan note offered for sale is neither a sale of the building nor any change to it. If the note trades and the lender takes the building, that is the entry.
